Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using a FLAG-tagged THRB protein to identify interacting partners. Label-free quantification is inferred from the lack of isobaric/SILAC tags and the use of peptide counting.

organism: The resulting fragmentation spectra were correlated against the Refseq entries for homo sapiens
cell_lines: THRB-FLAG-HepG2 cells were cultured in 10-cm cell culture plates
scope: we performed immunoprecipitation (IP) of THRB in THRB-FLAG HepG2 cells with anti-FLAG antibody, followed by mass-spectrometry to identify THRB-binding proteins
The clear lysates were incubated with 100 µL protein G dynabeads (Thermo Fisher 10003D) for 2 hours at 4°C. Pellets were washed 4 times with NP40 buffer.
For mass-spectrometry, the dynabeads samples were washed and resuspended in a Tris/ Urea buffer, reduced with dithiothreitol, alkylated with iodoacetamide and digested with trypsin
